tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise}1. ch3:3-6Show that two Riemannian metrics $g_1$ and $g_2$ are conformal if and only if they define the same angles but not necessarily the same lengths, and that a diffeomorphism is a conformal equivalence if and only if it preserves angles. [Hint: Let $(E_i)$ be a local orthonormal frame for $g_1$, and consider the $g_2$-angle between $E_i$ and $(\cos \theta )E_i + (\sin \theta )E_j$.] (Used on p. 59.) \end{exercise}
